params.body:
Step one of the testing question: get the logic out of the view, so a cheap test can reach it.

The switches in the dealer list lived as an inline `<script>` in `settings/dealer/index.blade.php`. That is the real reason this morning's failure was carried by nothing: **a script in a view cannot be called by any test**, so the only options were reading the source or opening a browser. The source-level guard from #745 catches a return to direct binding, but it clicks nothing.

Now `resources/js/dealer-switches.js` holds the behaviour and the blade carries only what Blade knows — the route and the translations, on one `data-dealer-switches` element.

**The test does what the autofilter does.** It builds the table, initialises, then throws the rows away and appends new nodes exactly as `x-ui.autofilter` does, and only then flips the switch. Six cases: a row from the first load, a row that arrived after a search, "no" at the confirmation saving nothing, a failed save putting the tick back with a message, the CSRF token read at call time rather than at load, and the demo flag never asking.

Verified to bite: putting the direct binding back fails exactly one test — *"bewaart ook een module van een rij die na een zoekopdracht binnenkwam"*. This morning's bug, caught in one second.

**Along the way, no jQuery on this path.** `fetch` reads the CSRF token at the moment of the call, which is the token the session guard refreshes (R S1-9.23); `$.ajaxSetup` copied it once at load.

**New: a JS test layer.** vitest + jsdom, `npm run test:js`, and a CI job next to the lint (`The front-end modules behave`). jsdom rather than a real browser on purpose: what is tested here is DOM behaviour, and that needs no browser. Real browser tests belong at the top of the pyramid for a handful of paths; this is the cheap layer under it. Lint stays at 31 warnings — the new files add none.

`R P2-1.10` extended; the PHP guard from #745 now checks that the blade does *not* get its own script back.

Full PHP suite green except `ListPageHeadersTest` (`requirement.index`, `links.index`), which fails the same way on this branch's base with my changes stashed, and which passed CI on #745 and #746. It looks like local database state; CI is the judge.
params.title: The dealer switches are a module with a test
